groups.title: Steel Repairs
groups.summary: Shipside steel and pipeline renewal, fabrication and onboard welding.
groups.intro: We renew steel and pipelines shipside and fabricate structural and pipe work for vessels, from catwalks and railings to stopper plates, reducers and stainless-steel tank repairs.

services.title: Shipside Steel Renewal
services.text: Steel renewal carried out shipside, along with pipeline renewal.

services.title: Structural and Pipe Fabrication
services.text: Structural and pipe fabrication for vessels, with prefabrication and supply.

services.title: Stopper Plates and D-Rings
services.text: Fabrication of stopper plates in all sizes, and welding of stoppers and D-rings onboard the vessel.

services.title: Reducers
services.text: Reducers fabricated in carbon steel and stainless steel, for purchase or rental.

services.title: Special Projects
services.text: Special projects such as stainless-steel tank and pipeline repairs.

groups.title: Machinery Repair, Service, and Overhaul
groups.summary: Main and auxiliary engines, deck machinery, HVAC, electrical and automation.
groups.intro: Our service engineers repair, service and overhaul the machinery aboard your vessel, from main and auxiliary engines to cranes, deck hydraulics, refrigeration and bridge navigation equipment.

services.title: Main and Auxiliary Engines
services.text: Main engine and auxiliary engine overhaul and retrofit, including M/E HP pumps, plungers and barrels, and pistons and liners.
points: M/E HP pumps, plungers and barrels

services.title: Pumps, Compressors and Boilers
services.text: Pumps, compressors and blowers, and boilers.

services.title: Refrigeration and HVAC
services.text: Refrigeration and HVAC maintenance, repairs, inspections and testing.

services.title: Deck Machinery and Cranes
services.text: Windlass, mooring winch and deck machinery, with crane services and deck hydraulics.

services.title: Electrical and Automation
services.text: Electrical and automation work, and electric motors supplied or serviced.

groups.intro: We inspect, audit and assess vessels, including condition reporting on the owner's behalf, pre-purchase and Pre-SIRE and Pre-USCG inspections, and testing from NDT to gauge calibration.

services.title: Vessel Inspection and Condition
services.text: Vessel inspection reports and vessel condition assessment, with condition reporting on the owner's behalf.

services.title: Audits and Investigations
services.text: Audits, damage and incident investigation, and MARPOL audits and investigation.

services.title: Annual Inspections
services.text: Lifeboat annual inspections and elevator annual inspections.

services.title: Testing and Calibration

about.title: More than a ship repair company.
text: At US Marine Works, we are committed collaborators dedicated to ensuring the seamless operation of vessels. Established in Houston, Texas, USA, our team collectively holds over 100 years of experience in the marine repair industry.

Our commitment extends beyond routine repairs: we collaborate with ship owners and management to optimize vessel performance for their customers. Whether your vessel requires technical services at docks, anchorage or ports worldwide, our qualified repair teams are ready to meet your needs.

From sailing with your vessel to completing repairs in any port, we hold to high standards of craftsmanship. We understand the urgency of maritime operations, so we offer timely and efficient assistance along with our expertise.
